name: gate-all-dp
summary: Standby gate v4: with automatic input, standby is refused while a source is active on any DP-class connector (DP or USB-C), not only the current one; fixed input: the selected one; no answer from the front-end: refused. v4: in link-held standby and every 5 s of "No signal" with automatic input, the input is routed to a connector with an active link (a new one first, alternating every 30 s if both), so its video is found
status: v2 hardware-tested 2026-10-08: automatic input, both outputs off -> deep standby, no wake for minutes; after a key wake the dock held the DP link (DP: source active) -> link-held standby, deep standby as soon as the dock released the link. v3 (edge wake) did not help (2026-10-08); v4 (routing in link-held standby) untested

g_lhs (image head zero area 0x201900): route a connector with an active link (sub_23F836, settings +0x5B)
g_tick (image head zero area 0x201350): routing check every 5 s of the No-signal countdown
